title: Paxos gradient hero card
description: A wide 8px-radius card washed with a faint aqua light at the top-left and a lime light at the bottom-right, holding a large regular-weight three-line title, a short lead and a small slate pill. On desktop the text sits left over a 550px-tall card and the art slot fills the right half down to the bottom edge; on phones the text is centred at the top and the art rises from the bottom of the card. Static: no motion.
notes: the art slot is cropped by the card (cover); pass a transparent render or a full-bleed image
